analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($2,479.57) above SMA5 ($2,461.63), SMA20 ($2,247.34), and SMA50 ($2,030.83): indicating short- to mid-term bullish trend.
· Above SMA100 ($1,895.97) and SMA200 ($2,025.32) confirms mid- to long-term bullish trend.
· Position at 29.9% of 52-week range suggests entry into historical low territory.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (77.6→69.7): cooling from overbought zone, trending downwards.
· MACD histogram trajectory (49.4251→6.6466): slowing improvement, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band position near middle band ($2,247.34): neutral zone, with a wide band width (47.92%).
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at $2,443.96: based on Pivot (PP) and SMA20.
· Swing resistance at $2,520.41: breakout could lead to further gains.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (Sideways): lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.96x): moderate confidence in current price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): requires observation and reconfirmation of support levels.
